items.title: Bob Coquille Interview, 1978-11-20
items.q: I heard Danny Rubio, who I'd never heard play tuba before

ctx.x: Well, I haven't heard too many young groups. Actually, I haven't. I don't have the opportunity to hear them if I knew where I might be able to hear them, Dick. I'd be glad.

Well, I was just wandering around Jackson Square yesterday, and I heard Danny Rubio, who I'd never heard play tuba before, that I remember. It's a phone, actually. And he seemed to be playing a new style.
Was that right? Was that group a young group?
